title: Oxyide Forge — HTTP Service Overview
description: Request rate, error rate, latency, and status distribution from Forge's bounded Prometheus metrics (METRICS_ENABLED=true). Labels method/route/status only; route is a Fastify template, never a raw URL.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Per-second completed-request rate, grouped by route template and status. A flat zero means no traffic, not necessarily health — check error rate alongside.

panels.title: HTTP error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Per-second 5xx rate. forge_http_errors_total increments only for status >= 500 (telemetry plugin); 4xx responses are client errors and are NOT counted here — see status distribution for the full mix.

panels.title: Request latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Estimated latency quantiles from the fixed-bucket histogram (14 edges, 5ms–10s). Quantiles are estimates derived from bucket counts, not exact measurements.

panels.title: HTTP status distribution
panels.description: Share of completed responses by status code over the selected window. Includes 2xx, 4xx, and 5xx — use alongside the 5xx-only error rate panel.

panels.title: Request volume by method and route
panels.description: Total completed requests grouped by method and route template. Route values are normalized Fastify templates (or 'unknown'), never raw URLs.
